capabilities: Decrypt notes in memory for editing
extras: Warning: There is no password recovery. While a note is unlocked, its text sits on disk unencrypted.
intentEvidence: Enclave is a fork of Locky by boinkdevteam, which is itself a fork of Lockbox by Danzar.
problem: Users need a way to encrypt sensitive notes and entire folders within their local vault while maintaining note names and internal links for search and navigation.

summary: Enclave encrypt notes and entire folders using AES-256 encryption, allowing notes to remain searchable and linked while locked.
